subject: Add ENGINE_CHECK_RDB_NAME to the 'test' target dependencies in Makefile (#2258)
reason: The change only adds ENGINE_CHECK_RDB_NAME (valkey-check-rdb) to the Makefile 'test' target's prerequisites so it gets built before the test suite runs. It is a build/CI change with no modification to any runtime code path, command behavior, reply, persistence, or tool logic; there is nothing a fuzzer scenario could exercise.
